as_told.title: Filippo Biondi's radar scans of structures under the pyramid

plain: This story is about the pyramids at Giza in Egypt. A podcast host, Joe Rogan, says there is real evidence of structures under the pyramids that may go as deep as 2 kilometres. Another podcast host, Jesse Michels, credits an Italian radar scientist named Filippo Biondi, and a man named Christopher Dunn, and says scans in 2025 show coiled columns down there. Michels says Biondi found them using a kind of radar imaging that can see beneath the ground, and that the shapes look like an energy system. If true, it would mean the pyramids were built for more than anyone has assumed.
